question: Should core Skill Workshop adopt exact proposal previews and snapshot-bound pending approvals as its permanent operator-review contract, including whether Gateway clients need the same read method now?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but it adds a new core capability and intentionally changes pending-approval behavior; repository history does not show a maintainer decision establishing that permanent product and API boundary.

options.title: Adopt the full contract
options.body: Land the canonical review service and snapshot-bound pending approvals, adding Gateway parity if operator clients are expected to consume the same projection.

options.title: Narrow the first release
options.body: Ship read-only CLI and agent previews while deferring approval snapshot binding or Gateway exposure to a separately approved compatibility change.

options.title: Decline the core expansion
options.body: Close the PR and linked issue if Skill Workshop should remain summary-and-inspect based rather than add a larger preview lifecycle.

recommendation.title: Adopt the full contract
recommendation.body: Land the canonical review service and snapshot-bound pending approvals, adding Gateway parity if operator clients are expected to consume the same projection.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available ownership signal is recent work on Skill Workshop's filesystem and safety boundary, while approval behavior is shared with ZengWen-DT's adjacent path.
